objective: Measure end-to-end Hybrid-NIDS performance under controlled packet replay at 0.5x, 1x, 2x and maximum sustainable rate.

traffic_profile.exclusion_note: Primary E6 workload is frozen before final performance runs. DoS may be used only as a separately labelled stress diagnostic and must not replace the frozen primary workload.

repetitions.minimum_between_run_condition: Previous processes stopped, response queue drained or timeout recorded, and at least 30 seconds idle before the next measured run.

nfstream.flow_expiration_definition: Observed live flow expiration is timestamped when NFStreamer yields the expired flow. It is not inferred from offline PCAP processing.

suricata.version_disclosure: E6 performance uses Suricata 7.0.3. It must not be reported as Suricata 8.0.4.

response_pipeline.policy_semantics: Do not force an execution action merely to obtain a timestamp. Primary traces preserve the frozen response policy. Execution timestamps are NA when policy does not invoke execution.
response_pipeline.execution_control: Actual execution-effect timing, when required, is validated separately inside the isolated e4-fw container and is not substituted for primary end-to-end traffic measurements.

timing_method.wall_clock: UTC Unix epoch timestamp for cross-process correlation
timing_method.monotonic_clock: time.perf_counter_ns() for elapsed-time measurements within each process
timing_method.missing_stage_rule: Use NA when a stage is not invoked. Never encode a missing timestamp or latency as zero.

drop_measurement.packet_delivery: Compare tcpreplay transmitted packet count with packet count observed on the isolated receive interface.
drop_measurement.suricata_capture_drop: Record Suricata capture.kernel_drops or equivalent stats separately from replay-interface packet loss.
drop_measurement.pipeline_flow_drop_count: NFStreamer flows emitted minus flow records successfully normalized/indexed for the same run.
drop_measurement.flow_reference_note: Offline reference flow count may be reported as a validation reference but is not silently treated as a native NFStreamer drop counter.

reported_latency_statistics.reporting_rule: For each rate and stage, report estimate plus 95% CI. Measured repetitions are the resampling clusters.

maximum_sustainable.definition: Highest validated replay multiplier for which all five measured repetitions satisfy every frozen acceptance criterion.

search_procedure.if_2x_passes: Probe 4x, 8x, 16x and continue doubling until first failure.
search_procedure.if_2x_fails: Bracket between the highest passing required rate and the lowest failing required rate.
search_procedure.if_0_5x_fails: Probe 0.25x, 0.125x, 0.0625x and 0.03125x until a passing lower bound is found.
search_procedure.refinement: Bisect the passing/failing bracket until the multiplier interval is no greater than 0.125x.
search_procedure.final_validation: Run one warm-up plus five measured repetitions at the candidate MAX rate. If any measured repetition fails, step down to the next lower frozen search candidate and repeat validation.
search_procedure.no_pass_rule: If no candidate down to 0.03125x passes, report that no maximum sustainable rate was established within the tested range. Do not invent a passing MAX value.

change_control.rule: After this freeze, no model, threshold, feature order, workload selection, warm-up count, repetition count, CI method or MAX acceptance criterion may be changed in response to measured results.
change_control.permitted_changes: Instrumentation bug fixes are permitted only before final measured runs and must be versioned, hashed and documented. Any such change requires a new code hash but does not permit changing the frozen statistical acceptance criteria.
